title: Two-measure 5r-covering bound (Vitali)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let μ, ν be measures on ℝᴾ (Euclid P), let A, B ⊆ ℝᴾ, r : ℝᴾ → ℝ, R₀ ∈ ℝ and c ∈ [0, ∞]. Suppose that for every y ∈ A: 0 < r(y) ≤ R₀, the closed ball B_{r(y)}(y) is contained in B, and μ(A ∩ B_{5r(y)}(y)) ≤ c·ν(B_{r(y)}(y)). Then μ(A) ≤ c·ν(B). No measurability of A, B or r is assumed; μ(A) is the outer measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (A B : Set (Euclid P)) (r : Euclid P → ℝ) (R₀ : ℝ) (c : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ y ∈ A, 0 < r y ∧ r y ≤ R₀ ∧ closedBall y (r y) ⊆ B ∧ μ (A ∩ closedBall y (5 * r y)) ≤ c * ν (closedBall y (r y))) → μ A ≤ c * ν B
